title: Engineering Graphics — Foundations of Projection
description: Learn technical drawing in 3D through seven interactive, orbitable guided-stepper lessons: the two reference planes (HP & VP), the types of engineering lines and dimensioning on a machine part, the four dihedral quadrants, and first-angle projection with the planes unfolding about the xy line — then two simulations for projecting points and straight lines onto the HP and VP across all four quadrants, with traces and true length. Follows First Angle Projection (SP 46:2003 / BIS).
